# Relational Migrator

> Migrate data from relational databases to MongoDB using Relational Migrator. Relational Migrator supports data modeling, schema design, and data migration.

- [API & Developer Reference](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/api-developer-reference.md): Learn about the Relational Migrator REST API and file locations for configuration, JDBC drivers, and logs.
- [Relational Migrator REST API](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/api-docs.md): Learn about the MongoDB Relational Migrator REST API and how to use it.
- [Pre-Migration Analysis](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/app-analysis.md)
- [The Pre-Migration Analysis Report](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/app-analysis/analysis-report.md): Learn how to read the Pre-Migration Analysis report in Relational Migrator, including the detection breakdown, database object overview, and prerequisites for migration.
- [Migration Risk Reference](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/app-analysis/risk-reference.md)
- [Run Pre-Migration Analysis](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/app-analysis/run-analysis.md)
- [Migration Benchmarks](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/benchmarks.md): Explore Relational Migrator data migration performance benchmark results, and recommendations to optimize and plan your relational-to-MongoDB migration.
- [Connect to Databases](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/database-connections.md)
- [Load a Data Definition Language File](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/database-connections/create-project-loading-schema-files.md): Create a project in Relational Migrator by importing schema files, selecting tables, and configuring initial mappings for MongoDB schema migration.
- [Use Relational Migrator With a Sample Schema](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/database-connections/create-project-sample-schema.md): Create a project using a sample schema in Relational Migrator to test migration jobs without a relational database, with options for Docker or PostgreSQL setup.
- [Connect to DB2](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/database-connections/db2.md)
- [Manage Database Connections](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/database-connections/manage-database-connections.md)
- [Use Relational Migrator Without a Live Database Connection](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/database-connections/migrator-without-live-connection.md)
- [Connect to MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/database-connections/mongodb.md)
- [Connect to MySQL](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/database-connections/mysql.md)
- [Connect to Oracle](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/database-connections/oracle.md)
- [Connect to PostgreSQL](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/database-connections/postgres.md)
- [Connect to SQL Server](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/database-connections/sql-server.md)
- [Connect to Sybase ASE](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/database-connections/sybase.md)
- [Diagrams](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/diagrams.md)
- [Manage Diagrams](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/diagrams/manage-diagrams.md): Create, clone, rename, or delete entity-relationship diagrams from the Mapping screen.
- [Clone a Diagram](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/diagrams/manage-diagrams/clone-diagrams.md): Clone existing diagrams in Relational Migrator to create new ones with the same entities, and then edit, rename, or delete the new diagrams as needed.
- [Create a Diagram](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/diagrams/manage-diagrams/create-diagrams.md): Create and manage diagrams in Relational Migrator to visualize tables, relationships, and data types, with options to clone, rename, and delete diagrams.
- [Delete a Diagram](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/diagrams/manage-diagrams/delete-diagrams.md): Delete diagrams in Relational Migrator by navigating to the diagram, opening the Diagram Properties pane, and confirming the deletion.
- [Rename a Diagram](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/diagrams/manage-diagrams/rename-diagrams.md): Rename diagrams in Relational Migrator by updating the name in the Diagram Properties pane on the Mapping screen.
- [Navigate Diagrams and Entities](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/diagrams/navigate-diagrams.md)
- [Apply a Layout to a Diagram](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/diagrams/navigate-diagrams/apply-layout.md): Apply a preset layout to organize diagram entities in Relational Migrator, with options for different layout styles.
- [Working with Entities](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/diagrams/navigate-diagrams/working-with-entities.md)
- [Copy Entities](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/diagrams/navigate-diagrams/working-with-entities/copy-entities.md): Copy entities to customize diagrams in MongoDB by selecting entities and choosing to copy them to a new or existing diagram.
- [Delete Entities](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/diagrams/navigate-diagrams/working-with-entities/delete-entities.md): Delete entities from your Relational or MongoDB model to customize diagram size and focus, with options to revert deletions.
- [Toggle Visibility of Entities](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/diagrams/navigate-diagrams/working-with-entities/hide-entities.md): Show or hide entities in diagrams to focus on specific relationships and reduce clutter without affecting the model.
- [Move Entities](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/diagrams/navigate-diagrams/working-with-entities/move-entities.md): Move entities between diagrams to customize data visualization in MongoDB, either to a new or existing diagram.
- [Select Entities](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/diagrams/navigate-diagrams/working-with-entities/select-entities.md): Select and manage entities in diagram view or schema model pane, including moving, copying, deleting, or hiding them.
- [Understand Diagrams](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/diagrams/understand-diagrams.md): Interpret diagrams in Relational Migrator, showing relationships between entities in relational and MongoDB databases with various view modes and color coding.
- [Relational Migrator Overview](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/getting-started.md): MongoDB Relational Migrator is a tool to help you migrate your relational workloads to MongoDB. This page describes key features and supported databases.
- [User Interface Overview](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/getting-started/overview.md): Explore the UI elements of Relational Migrator to manage project appearance, functionality, and capabilities, including navigation, connections, and diagrams.
- [What is Relational Migrator](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/index.md): Migrate data from relational databases to MongoDB using Relational Migrator. Relational Migrator supports data modeling, schema design, and data migration.
- [Installation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/installation.md): Explore various installation methods for Relational Migrator, including local, server, and Docker.
- [Application Settings](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/installation/application-settings.md)
- [Relational Migrator File Locations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/installation/file-location.md): Find file locations for configuration, JDBC drivers, and logs for Relational Migrator on Mac, Windows, and Linux systems.
- [Development Installation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/installation/install-on-a-local-machine.md)
- [Install on Mac](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/installation/install-on-a-local-machine/install-mac.md): Install Relational Migrator on a Mac by downloading the binary, dragging the app to Applications, and optionally adding database drivers.
- [Install on RHEL](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/installation/install-on-a-local-machine/install-rhel.md): Install Relational Migrator on a RHEL/CentOS machine using default settings, with optional steps for connecting to Oracle or MySQL drivers.
- [Install on Ubuntu](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/installation/install-on-a-local-machine/install-ubuntu.md): Install Relational Migrator on Ubuntu by downloading the `.deb` binary, installing it, and optionally adding drivers such as MySQL, or Oracle.
- [Install on Windows](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/installation/install-on-a-local-machine/install-windows.md): Install Relational Migrator on a Windows machine using default settings, and optionally add drivers for Oracle or MySQL.
- [Install on Linux](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/installation/install-on-a-local-machine/linux.md): Install Relational Migrator on a linux machine using default settings, with optional steps for connecting to Oracle or MySQL drivers.
- [Production Installation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/installation/install-on-an-unattended-server.md)
- [Debian Systems Installation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/installation/install-on-an-unattended-server/debian-server-installation.md)
- [RHEL/CentOS Systems Installation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/installation/install-on-an-unattended-server/rhel-centos-server-installation.md)
- [Windows Server Installation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/installation/install-on-an-unattended-server/windows-server-installation.md)
- [Install with Docker](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/installation/install-with-docker.md): Install and run Relational Migrator as a Docker container, ensuring an OS-independent and easily replicable setup process.
- [System Requirements](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/installation/system-requirements.md): Check system requirements for running Relational Migrator, including hardware, memory, network, operating systems, and web browsers.
- [Create a Migration Job](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/jobs/creating-jobs.md): Create a Snapshot migration job to transfer data and schemas from a relational database to MongoDB.
- [Data Verification](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/jobs/data-verification.md)
- [Use Data Verification](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/jobs/data-verification/use-data-verification.md): Enable and monitor data verification for migration jobs, view status updates, and troubleshoot issues in the verification process.
- [Monitor a Migration Job](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/jobs/monitoring-jobs.md): Monitor migration jobs in the History pane, view job stages, and check for errors in the Issues pane on the Data Migration tab.
- [Create a Relational Migrator User in MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/jobs/prerequisites/create-mongodb-user.md)
- [Configure Migration Prerequisites for DB2](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/jobs/prerequisites/db2.md)
- [Configure Migration Prerequisites for MySQL](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/jobs/prerequisites/my-sql.md): Configure MySQL for migration jobs by setting up user permissions and enabling binary logging for continuous data replication.
- [Configure Migration Prerequisites for Oracle](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/jobs/prerequisites/oracle.md): Configure Oracle database prerequisites for migration with Relational Migrator including setting user permissions and enabling archive and supplemental logging.
- [Configure Migration Prerequisites for PostgreSQL](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/jobs/prerequisites/postgres.md): Configure PostgreSQL for migration jobs by adjusting settings, granting permissions, and enabling logical replication for data migration.
- [Configure Migration Prerequisites for SQL Server](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/jobs/prerequisites/sql-server.md): Configure SQL Server for migration jobs by enabling CDC at the database and table levels, using scripts generated by Relational Migrator.
- [Stop a Migration Job](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/jobs/stopping-jobs.md): Stop a migration job from the Job Overview pane, affecting the destination database based on the job type and stage.
- [Data Migration](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/jobs/sync-jobs.md): Explore how to transfer data from relational databases to MongoDB using snapshot migration jobs with Relational Migrator.
- [JSON Schema](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/json-schema.md): Learn how to export your JSON Schema and download sample documents using Relational Migrator.
- [Download All Files](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/json-schema/download-all-files.md): Generate and download all JSON Schema and sample document files for your MongoDB applications using Relational Migrator.
- [Download a Single File](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/json-schema/download-single-file.md): Generate and download individual JSON schema and sample document files for your MongoDB applications using Relational Migrator.
- [Create Mapping Rules](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/create-rules.md)
- [Delete Rules](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/delete-rules.md): Delete mapping rules in Relational Migrator to prevent collections from being recreated, and manually remove collections from your MongoDB cluster.
- [Edit Rules](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/edit-rules.md): Update mapping rules for migration jobs, including changing collection and field names, and setting BSON types, and null handling options.
- [Example: Insurance Data Models](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/example-insurance-data.md)
- [Connect to Relational Migrator](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/example-insurance-data/connect.md)
- [Migrate Your Data to MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/example-insurance-data/migrate-data.md)
- [Refactor the Claim Domain](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/example-insurance-data/refactor-claim-domain.md)
- [Refactor the Litigation Domain](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/example-insurance-data/refactor-litigation-domain.md)
- [Refactor the Party Domain](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/example-insurance-data/refactor-party-domain.md)
- [Refactor the Policy Domain](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/example-insurance-data/refactor-policy-domain.md)
- [Calculated Fields](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/fields/calculated-fields.md)
- [Add Calculated Fields](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/fields/calculated-fields/add-calculated-fields.md): Create calculated fields in MongoDB documents using JavaScript expressions to combine existing database column values during migration jobs.
- [Customize ID Fields](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/fields/calculated-fields/customized-id-fields.md): Customize `_id` fields during migration by changing their BSON data type and using JavaScript expressions to ensure unique values.
- [Delete Calculated Fields](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/fields/calculated-fields/delete-calculated-fields.md): Delete calculated fields from your mapping rule to prevent updates in future migration jobs.
- [Edit Calculated Fields](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/fields/calculated-fields/edit-calculated-fields.md): Update JavaScript expressions for calculated fields in MongoDB, with changes applied after the next migration job.
- [View Calculated Fields](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/fields/calculated-fields/view-calculated-fields.md): View existing calculated fields to see the JavaScript expressions that generate their values in a mapping rule.
- [Data Type Conversion Reference](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/fields/data-type-conversion-guide.md): Explore examples of converting data types to BSON using customized fields in Relational Migrator, including error handling and BsonNull values during migration.
- [Fields](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/fields/field-customizations.md): Use Relational Migrator to define calculated fields, create custom IDs, and convert data types to BSON, with options for embedding, and null handling.
- [Data Modeling](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/introduction.md)
- [Manage Mapping Rules](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/manage-rules.md)
- [Embedded Array](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/mapping-rule-options/embedded-array.md): Use the Embedded array mapping rule to insert child table values as array elements in a parent collection, configuring foreign key and array condition options.
- [Embedded Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/mapping-rule-options/embedded-documents.md): Use the Embedded Documents mapping rule to denormalize foreign key relationships by embedding or merging child documents into a parent collection in MongoDB.
- [Mapping Rule Options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/mapping-rule-options/introduction.md)
- [Mapping Rule Filters](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/mapping-rule-options/mapping-rule-filters.md): Filter data during migration using JavaScript expressions to include or exclude rows based on specified conditions.
- [New Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/mapping-rule-options/new-documents.md): Create a dedicated collection for each table row using the New Documents mapping rule in Relational Migrator.
- [Rename a Collection](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/mapping-rule-options/rename-collection.md): Rename a collection on the Mapping screen by selecting it and entering a new name, ensuring the name is not already in use.
- [Create Rules From Suggested Mappings](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/new-rules-suggested-mappings.md): Utilize Relational Migrator to create mapping rules from suggested mappings based on your relational schema for faster MongoDB data model development.
- [Schema Mapping](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/schema-mapping.md): Facilitate schema mapping from relational databases to MongoDB using Relational Migrator's customizable mapping rules.
- [Add a Synthetic Foreign Key](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/synthetic-foreign-key/add-foreign-key.md): Define synthetic foreign keys in Relational Migrator to establish relationships between tables without existing foreign keys in the source database.
- [Synthetic Foreign Keys](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/synthetic-foreign-key/synthetic-foreign-keys.md): Create synthetic foreign keys in Relational Migrator to define relationships between tables without existing foreign keys in the source database.
- [View Rules](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/mapping-rules/view-rules.md): View mapping rules in the Schema model pane by selecting a table or collection name under the Relational or MongoDB headings.
- [Create and Manage Projects](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/projects.md)
- [Project Settings](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/projects/configure-settings.md): Configure settings for a Relational Migrator project, including key handling options, global casing, and suggested mappings.
- [Create a Project By Connecting to a Live Database](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/projects/create-project-live-connection.md): Create a project by connecting to a live database, providing connection details, selecting tables for migration, and choosing collection naming conventions.
- [Manage Projects](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/projects/manage-projects.md)
- [Manage the Relational Model](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/projects/manage-relational-connection.md): Manage schemas and tables for migration projects by connecting to databases or using DDL files, and change database connections for different environments.
- [Release Notes for Relational Migrator](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/release-notes.md): Explore the latest changes, features, improvements, and bug fixes in Relational Migrator, including new supported databases, and enhanced migration performance.
- [Table Filters](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/table-filters.md)
- [Apply Table Filters](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/table-filters/apply-table-filters.md): Use table filters to migrate specific subsets of table data by applying SQL where and row limit clauses during the creation of mapping rules.
- [Delete Table Filters](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/table-filters/delete-table-filters.md): Delete existing table filters to remove SQL where statements and row limits when pulling data from your table.
- [Edit Table Filters](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/relational-migrator/table-filters/edit-table-filters.md): Edit table filters to modify SQL where statements and adjust row limits for data retrieval.
